descriptionHtml:
Intel Core Ultra 5 Processor 245KF (24M Cache / Up to 5.20 GHz / 14 Cores & 14 Threads / LGA 1851 Socket / DDR5 Support / PCIe 5.0 / Unlocked / Intel AI Boost NPU / Official 1-Year Local Agent Warranty)

Unleash high-efficiency gaming and AI-accelerated performance with the Intel Core Ultra 5 Processor 245KF, available at Turbo Computer Egypt backed by an official 1-Year agent warranty. Built on the LGA 1851 socket architecture, this unlocked desktop processor features 14 cores (6 Performance-cores and 8 Efficient-cores) delivering up to 5.20 GHz Max Turbo Frequency with 24MB Intel Smart Cache. Equipped with integrated Intel AI Boost NPU for accelerated AI processing, native DDR5 memory support, and PCIe 5.0 readiness for next-gen GPUs and SSD storage setups.
